# SaveTowards

> SaveTowards is a free web app that turns a savings goal and target date into a simple, actionable savings rate — how much to set aside per day, week, month, or paycheck to get there on time.

SaveTowards is for anyone with a savings goal (a trip, a gift, an emergency fund, a big purchase) who wants a clear number to act on, not a budgeting or investment tool. There is no interest or inflation modeling — just straightforward division of the amount remaining by the time remaining.

Key facts:
- Free to use, no account or sign-up required.
- All data is stored locally in the user's browser (localStorage). Nothing is sent to a server or shared with third parties.
- No backend, no database, no authentication.
- Users can track multiple goals at once, each with its own target amount, target date, and progress visualization.
- The core output is a single headline number (e.g. "$47/week") with an optional breakdown by day, week, month, and pay period.

## Pages

- [SaveTowards](https://savetowards.com/): The app itself. Single page — create a goal, see your required savings rate, and track progress toward it.
